q: Which traffic sources bring people who actually buy, not just visit, and what are we paying for them?
answer:
By order date for sales & orders, delivery date for ad spend (P&L basis) and session date for sessions: Meta and Google drive almost all buyers; Google is substantially more efficient.

- Big picture: Meta 91 orders (₹1,92,636 net sales) with ₹2,01,194 ad spend → cost per order ₹2,211 and net ROAS ~0.96. Google 96 orders (₹1,88,395) with ₹1,12,507 ad spend → cost per order ₹1,172 and net ROAS ~1.67. Google buys similar volume at notably lower cost and higher ROAS.
- Organic and unattributed bring small, unpaid demand: Organic 8 orders (₹13,886) with 310 sessions; Unattributed 11 orders (₹13,115) with 1,689 sessions — both have no ad spend. WhatsApp recorded 1 order (₹2,118) and 65 sessions with no ad spend.
- So-what: Google is the most efficient paid source (higher ROAS, lower CPO); Meta drives similar order volume but at higher cost; non-paid channels contribute modest direct purchases without spend.

Worth checking: campaign-level breakdowns inside Meta and Google to find which campaigns give the lower CPO / higher ROAS.

Period: 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-28 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-28
